title: Bis-pyrazolone-based dysprosium(III) complexes: zero-field single-molecule magnet behavior in the [2 × 2] grid Dy4 cluster

synthesis.procedure: Under ambient conditions, H2L1 (0.1 mmol) in 10 mL methanol was treated with Dy(III)X3·nH2O (X = NO3 or Cl−, 0.1 mmol) and triethylamine in a 1 : 1 : 2 ligand : metal : base molar ratio. After 10 min stirring, the mixture was filtered and set for slow evaporation for a week to afford diamond-shaped light yellow block crystals of 1. Crystals were washed with a small volume of methanol before characterization.
synthesis.time: 10 min stirring, then slow evaporation for 1 week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: ambient stirring followed by filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered and set for slow evaporation; diamond-shaped light yellow block crystals washed with methanol

properties.summary: Zero-field SMM with temperature-dependent multi-step (two-step in the 12–21 K regime) magnetization relaxation arising from two crystallographically independent Dy(III) centres. χMT at 300 K is 54.20 cm3 K mol−1; magnetization saturates near 20.09–20.30 μB. Effective barriers are Ueff = 58.25 K (slow relaxation, 1.9–11 K Raman/Orbach fit) and about 64 K for FR/SR processes at 12–21 K.

measurements.name: Ueff (slow relaxation)
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; Arrhenius/Raman–Orbach fit of ln τ vs T−1, 1.9–11 K; τ0 = 7.98×10−6 s, C = 9.08 s−1 K−1.63, n = 1.63

measurements.name: Ueff (fast relaxation, IT)
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; linear Arrhenius fit 12–21 K; τ0 = 4.95×10−5 s

measurements.name: Ueff (slow relaxation, IT)
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; linear Arrhenius fit 12–21 K; τ0 = 1.93×10−6 s

measurements.name: ac susceptibility χ″ maxima
measurements.conditions: zero dc field, 3 Oe oscillating field; frequency- and temperature-dependent out-of-phase maxima confirming SMM behaviour

properties.summary: Dinuclear centrosymmetric complex showing slow magnetic relaxation under zero applied field but without χ″ peak maxima (not a well-defined zero-field SMM). χMT at 300 K is 28.32 cm3 K mol−1; magnetization saturates near 11.93–12.07 μB.

measurements.conditions: zero dc field, 3 Oe oscillating field; non-superimposed χ″ signals without peak maxima, indicating slow relaxation
